neural.objective: Training-standardized execution-return MSE + .1 * training-standardized 5-bar OHLCV auxiliary MSE
neural.input: Raw 125 observed bars, fixed 25x5 patches; per-window log OHLC/log1p volume normalization, no pretrained tokenizer
neural.runtime: Existing CUDA deterministic float32 environment; TF32 off; four CPU threads; no installations

probe.objective: Mean unweighted binary log loss plus lambda/2 times sum of squared slopes in standardized coordinates. Intercept is not penalized. No auxiliary or return loss. Initialize slopes0 and intercept logit(training_up_frequency). Same single regularization value and full-batch float64 Newton solver for both families. No lambda, window, feature, seed or threshold search.

experiment: Controlled addition and removal of rolling-window training members in fixed annual coordinates
memberships: At each quarter cutoff q and preceding annual cutoff a, define A=rolling5 training members at a, Q=rolling5 members at q, N=Q minus A newly eligible members, O=A minus Q removed members, R=A intersect Q. Four arms: annual=A; add=A union Q=A union N; remove=A intersect Q=A minus O; both=Q. Sorted unique row identities, no duplication or resampling. Reset A each new year. At December all arms identical. A/Q use anchor date >=cutoff-5calendarYears+1day and joint_completed<=cutoff; includes all eligible weekdays. All ablation members must be mature by q. Added means newly eligible relative to annual set, including previously dated samples with newly matured labels. Add-only preserves old lower bound during that year and can exceed5years; remove-only adds no postannual members and has fewer observations. These are controlled membership interventions, not all fixed5year policies.
fixed_coordinates: Reuse R28 annual rolling5 natural20 networks, neural target scales, rep/market clipping and standardization, supervised annual R18 rays, vol/order residual projections, means and scales. No new neural fit, feature inference, scaler or interaction fit. Reuse verified R32 raw feature banks; apply the annual transformations to each quarter training and test row. Annual interactions need not remain orthogonal on the shifted quarter training sample; do not re-residualize.
fitting: New fits only add and remove arms at17nonDecembercutoffs x3seeds x4learnedmethods=408 endpoints /102jobs. Use R34 fixed-coordinate full-step fit_coefficients verbatim and identical probe/offset settings. No coefficient shrinkage, alpha search or new calibration. R18/R19/R23 fully optimize own coefficients on fixed annual design; R25 freezes same-arm same-cutoff R19 and fully fits scalar gamma. Reuse72annualheads and204full-roll R34endpoints exactly. R34 full-step predictions preserved exactly; do not substitute R32 updated transformations or R34 step25 as the both arm.
controls: Same272weeks and11 unchanged old policies. Each new arm native_MSE exactly annual native (no invented probability). Training-frequency control uses that arm own causal training label mean at each cutoff, not full-roll frequency. Learned probabilities are three-seed equal mean, strict>.5; signal cutoff strictly precedes signal date. Q1 all rows equal annual. All18rawannualfeaturebanks reused without new inference; each treatment training interface selects only its allowed members.
probability_accounting: Four probabilities at each identical seed-week: p0 annual, pA add-only, pR remove-only, pB both. Conditional add effects pA-p0 and pB-pR; conditional removal effects pR-p0 and pB-pA. Nonadditive remainder pB-pA-pR+p0. Average both operation orders: add_effect=.5*((pA-p0)+(pB-pR)); remove_effect=.5*((pR-p0)+(pB-pA)), sum exactly pB-p0. Compute from each seed actual sigmoid then average contributions, matching original ensemble. Never sigmoid(mean seed logit). These are specified order-averaged training-operation effects under fixed recipe; conditional effects also reported. Nonadditivity includes refitting and sigmoid, and is not the market/order feature interaction.
coefficient_accounting: For each nonDecembercutoff,seed,method reconstruct the same four coefficient vectors in annual standardized coordinates. Record both conditional changes, order-average changes and nonadditive vector; report coordinatewise changes, intercept, full-vector norms. These explain coefficient differences without attributing performance to coefficient norm alone. All vectors retain full same-arm R25/R19 offset relation.
reporting: Report all methods, seeds, years, two147/125periods and descriptive272pooledperiod. Probability effect summaries for all weeks and cases defined by both full-roll vs annual: regression/recovery/stable_correct/stable_wrong. Outcome-signed effects use (2actual_up-1)*deltaP, negative adverse. Dominant adverse add/remove only if < -1e-12, ties marked, no misleading share denominator. Include all2026weeks and flips for all3 altered arms, not only previously identified bad weeks. Freeze unlabelled seed effects before outcome summaries.
inference: 60 contrasts jointly Holm:2periods x3mainrecipes x2losses x5prespecifiededges (add vs annual; remove vs annual; both vs remove; both vs add; both vs annual). Same10000circular8-observationbootstrap seed20260910, centered two-sided p, marginal95CI. Both vs annual overlaps prior round, not independent evidence. Old60R34comparisons archived unchanged. No across-round correction, no performance-dependent arm selection.

Independently verify memberships, set-operation identities, maturity/quarter boundaries, source cache hashes, descriptor algebra and synthetic probability/vector accounting. Fit all408new endpoints before weekly scoring; freeze then score all new arms, evaluate, diagnose, independently verify and report. No revised protocol after seeing results.
verification: Independent L-BFGS-B and Brent for all408new plus204reused full-roll endpoints. Reconstruct annual coordinates; verify all153training interfaces by poisoning excluded features, descriptors and labels. Independent scalar probability and seed averaging, annual Q1 parity and own-arm frequencies. Verify all coefficient and probability effects and nonadditivity with alternate order-averaging algebra. Independent metric arithmetic and all60bootstrap/Holm contrasts. All5063oldfiles remain unchanged.
limits: All272outcomes previously seen; exploratory research, no new blind evaluation. Membership intervention changes sample count, class proportions, support and the mean-loss sample weights; it does not separately identify quantity versus quality or an individual sample causal effect. Annual transforms trained with allA remain fixed even in remove-only, so removal is only from coefficient-fitting loss, not erasing old information from neural network or transformations. This intentionally tests conditional head-level member influence, not a full-pipeline leave-out claim. Order-average accounting not unique natural causal importance; keep both conditional paths. No proof of regime causality or general WFO failure; no automatic model promotion or live changes. Preserve old R25recent73/125=58.4%.
